data.name: Saffiyah
data.gender_notes: Saffiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saffiyah is derived from the Arabic word 'safah', meaning 'bliss' or 'joy'. In Islam, it represents a state of happiness and contentment. The name Saffiyah carries the meaning “Blissful, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Saffiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody blissful, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saffiyah symbolizes the bliss and peace that comes from living a virtuous life, as described in the Quran.
data.etymology: Saffiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blissful, Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saffiyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: سفیہ
